hooks.name: Haunted repo expectations may be stale
hooks.description: Fires when the seeded demo repo changes. The acceptance test asserts expected.json row by row, so a new planted case without a row is silently unverified. IDE and CLI only.

action.prompt: The seeded haunted repo changed. Check that fixtures/haunted-repo/expected.json still covers every link in it, with the expected (verdict, cause) pair for each. A planted case with no row in expected.json is not actually verified by the acceptance test, which is the project's definition of done. If a new URL was added, confirm a provider fixture exists for it in fixtures/cache/ as well, because the test suite runs the cache in replay mode and a miss throws.
